Fabulous food & great for vegetarian & non vegetarian alike
Jul 2026 • Family
We ate here 3 times whilst in Saigon. Family of 4, 2 vegetarian & 2 carnivores. Everyone was happy with the food & drinks. Found off a local market street, it’s definitely a find. Recommend eating upstairs on the shaded & well fanned roof (no A/C). Evening atmosphere is buzzin but we also had a quiet lunch. Food goes the extra mile, Vietnamese staples + some great fusion menu items. Drinks menu is great and the on tap Heart of Darkness IPA is great.

Great treat in Ho Chi Minh
Jun 2026 • Couples
Saw the reviews of this place and had to give it a visit. Close to Nguyen Hue Walking Street and easy to find down a small busy street. Make sure you book as it is a busy restaurant with lots of reserved tables when we arrived ( we had booked) Shown to rooftop area which has a lovely chilled out feel with lovely seating. The menu is Vietnamese with a modern twist, we ordered fried mini spring rolls & grilled prawn & avocado wonton cups ( these were delicious) for starters and mains we had prawns in sweet savoury sauce but the stand out main was dry noodles with grilled chicken fillet and fresh avocado sauce, unbelievably good, 2 beers in happy hour BOGOF. A great evening at a total cost of £15.88. Very attentive staff and obviously a great chef.
